|rulings=* The Effect increases the targeted starfighter’s pilot capacity by one. It can target either player’s starfighter but does not permit Dark Side pilots to deploy to a Light Side starfighter. * When the target has more than one permanent pilot, the 2002 supplement removes all permanent pilots.<ref>[[:File:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Glossary Supplement]], page 2.</ref>
